verdict.rationale: Clerk ships an official CLI (clerk.com/cli, llms.txt) that scaffolds auth into a repo, manages webhooks locally, ships to production, and connects the Clerk MCP server to AI clients in one command — directly serving AI-native/agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI's reliability and no deeper detail on full command coverage beyond the marketing/docs pages.
